svg.title: Verification methods per block of WP-S-02
svg.desc: Stacked horizontal bars, one per safety function and one each for the common and security blocks, showing how many requirements each verification method covers: analysis, inspection, test and demonstration.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 17-1 Verification methods per block, counted from the Verif. column of 82 requirements

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A requirement with two methods counts once under each; the number at the end of a bar is its block's requirement count
